notes: Staging Cleanup QoL: Agent City now safely removes stale update payloads instead of letting update_staging accumulate indefinitely. Normal startup sweeps stale staging only when no update handoff is active; staging a new update also clears prior debris; and the update runner best-effort removes the exact version workspace it just installed. Active update_job.json or launcher handoff flags freeze cleanup entirely. This should clear existing leftover staging folders on the first restart after installing v1.1.6 and keep future update staging clean. No Simulation authority, citizen behavior, world truth, or autonomy changes.
